dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, did you sleep well during the storm last night?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, dɪd juː ˈsliːp ˈwɛl ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə ˈstɔːrm ˈlæst ˈnaɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not really. There was a power outage, and we didn't have lights for three hours.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli. ðɛr wʌz ə ˈpaʊər ˌaʊtɪdʒ, ənd wiː ˈdɪdənt ˈhæv ˈlaɪts fər ˈθriː ˈaʊərz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Three hours! What did you do?
dialogue.reading: ˈθriː ˈaʊərz! ˈwʌt dɪd juː ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: While the power was off, my roommate and I talked in the dark.
dialogue.reading: waɪl ðə ˈpaʊər wʌz ˈɔːf, maɪ ˈruːmmeɪt ənd aɪ ˈtɔːkt ɪn ðə ˈdɑːrk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Did you hear about the fire at the market during the storm?
dialogue.reading: dɪd juː ˈhɪr əˈbaʊt ðə ˈfaɪər ət ðə ˈmɑːrkɪt ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə ˈstɔːrm?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, luckily. The firefighters came quickly, and the fire burned for only an hour.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ˈlʌkəli. ðə ˈfaɪərfaɪtərz ˈkeɪm ˈkwɪkli, ənd ðə ˈfaɪər ˈbɜːrnd fər ˈoʊnli ən ˈaʊər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's good. When I was in Japan, there was a small earthquake during my trip.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɡʊd. wɛn aɪ wʌz ɪn dʒəˈpæn, ðɛr wʌz ə ˈsmɔːl ˈɜːrθkweɪk ˈdʊrɪŋ maɪ ˈtrɪp.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Earthquakes can be frightening. Were you scared?
dialogue.reading: ˈɜːrθkweɪks kən bi ˈfraɪtənɪŋ. wɜːr juː ˈskɛrd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A little. But it stopped after a minute, and luckily there wasn't a tsunami.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɪtəl. bʌt ɪt ˈstɑːpt ˈæftər ə ˈmɪnɪt, ənd ˈlʌkəli ðɛr ˈwʌzənt ə tsuˈnɑːmi.
